model_annotation: The figure is a line graph illustrating the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for three different consistency methods. The horizontal x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and features a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 8, marked by tick labels at intervals of 2. The vertical y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and uses a linear scale, with visible numeric tick marks ranging from 20 to 30 at intervals of 2, accompanied by corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines spanning the width of the plot. A legend in the bottom right corner maps the three plotted data series to their respective labels and visual styles: "Consistency-CE" is represented by a blue dashed line with open circular markers, "Consistency-Bi +sampling" is shown as an orange dashed line with open upward-pointing triangular markers, and "Consistency-Bi +beam" is depicted by a green dashed line with open square markers. The "Consistency-CE" line begins at an approximate coordinate of x = 0.4 and y = 19.1, rising to an end point near x = 7.7 and y = 28.6. The "Consistency-Bi +sampling" line starts around x = 0.2 and y = 24.2, ending near x = 7.8 and y = 29.4. Finally, the "Consistency-Bi +beam" line starts at approximately x = 0.5 and y = 23.3, terminating near x = 7.9 and y = 29.3. All three lines exhibit a continuous upward trajectory across the plotted x-axis range.
